scope: Four English physical parent identities; source-backed product descriptions and current parent-image verification. No database, Storage, child or pricing writes.

source_documents.supports: The standard Prismatic Evolutions Elite Trainer Box lists an Eevee full-art foil promo among its contents.
The announcement names Eevee as the standard ETB promo and describes two Eevee promos in the Pokémon Center ETB, with one carrying the Pokémon Center logo.
The standard Scarlet & Violet—151 Elite Trainer Box lists a Snorlax full-art foil promo among its contents.
The Pokémon Center 151 ETB lists both a Snorlax promo bearing the Pokémon Center logo and a Snorlax promo without that logo.

distribution.product_name: Scarlet & Violet—151 Pokémon Center Elite Trainer Box

public_copy.why_it_exists: Snorlax SVP 051 is the full-art foil promo included in the Scarlet & Violet—151 Elite Trainer Box. The Pokémon Center edition also includes this unstamped promo alongside a separately stamped copy.
public_copy.why_collectors_care: Its SVP 051 number and boxed-product origin distinguish this Snorlax promo from expansion cards. The Pokémon Center logo version is cataloged separately.
public_copy.how_to_identify: Look for Snorlax, the SVP 051 promo number, the woodland Snorlax illustration, and the absence of the Pokémon Center logo above the retreat cost.
public_copy.grookai_rule: The unstamped promo and Pokémon Center logo version are cataloged separately. Product information describes documented distribution, not the origin of an individual owned card.

image_review.child_finish_claim: No new exact child-finish certification; existing image/finish fields remain unchanged.
